Dive into a world of tranquility with this beautiful composition by A.R Rahman & Lata Mangeshkar, their flawless vocals have transformed this melodious devotional masterpiece and taken it to a whole new level.
Song Name - O Paalanhaare
Movie - Lagaan
Singer - Lata Mangeshkar & Udit Narayan
Composer - A.R. Rahman
Lyricist - Javed Akhtar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
2001 Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
